name: PicoClaw
description: Runs a lightweight Go personal assistant on low-cost Linux boards, Android phones, and desktops, with chat-app channels, MCP tools, skills, and cron reminders.

skills.name: Chat App Channels
skills.description: Connects the assistant to Telegram, Discord, Matrix, WeChat, and other messaging platforms through one shared gateway server.

skills.name: MCP Server Management
skills.description: Adds, lists, tests, and edits MCP servers with the picoclaw mcp commands so the agent can call external tools and data.

skills.name: Scheduled Reminders
skills.description: Sets one-time reminders, recurring tasks, and cron-expression jobs from natural language through the built-in cron tool.

skills.name: Skill Installation
skills.description: Searches and installs SKILL.md capability packs from ClawHub or GitHub registries with picoclaw skills search and install.

skills.name: Model Routing
skills.description: Routes simple queries to lightweight models with rule-based routing across 30+ providers, including local Ollama and vLLM.
